pairs.why: A has calm broad light on the posts and planks with a soft foam contact edge, while B's busy water caustics and many small highlights break the gentle form modeling of the real cards.
A has a broad soft form turn with one big sheen and a soft cast shadow to the lower side, like the real ball, while B's panels are darker and more edge-banded with a tighter shadow.
B has smoother, gentler metal shading with moderate highlights, while A has sharp, glossy lens reflections, a hard cast shadow and a plastic look.
A's body has a soft gradient with deep shadow on the sides, close to the real calculator, while B shows more thin bright rim and edge highlights.
A has a soft sheen on the canopy panels and a deeper underside shadow like the real umbrella, while B adds a brighter white gloss on the left panels.
B has soft, diffuse shading on the white casing with gentle shadow, like the real card, while A has strong glossy hot spots and high contrast.
A's thick rope has a smooth rounded form turn with soft highlights and a darker shadow side, while B's thin rope is flat and light with little form shadow.
Both ropes are thin, lightly shaded and have similar soft shadows, so lighting gives no reason to choose.
